rubrics.justification: Overall interpretation as a poor-quality early blastocyst is consistent with the image and provided 1DD grade, but some image-specific claims are overconfident or inaccurate (e.g., assigning ICM location at 6 o'clock, detailed cytoplasmic/metabolic stress features not directly visible).

It integrates age, ovarian reserve, endometriosis, BMI, sperm parameters, and endometrial thickness with embryo quality reasonably well, though some links (former smoking, likely trilaminar pattern) are speculative.

The reasoning is structured and generally consistent: very poor morphology drives prognosis despite favorable maternal age/reserve. Minor issues include overstated certainty about causes and using unsupported miscarriage estimates.

Core interpretation of a 1DD embryo as very poor prognosis is aligned, but several recommendations are not strongly guideline-based or are premature (ERA after no failures, oxidative stress markers, donor oocyte discussion after one poor cycle, embryo banking target of euploid embryos without context).
Provides practical transfer counseling and future-cycle considerations with alternatives, but some suggested tests/interventions are speculative or not clearly indicated in this first-cycle scenario.
